items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You had guys like Kenton and Boyd Raeburn who said go ahead and write whatever you want.

ctx.x: In those days, and I'm sure Handy and other people thought the same thing (inaudible). The way to do it is here, we have the tools. It was there to be done.
You had guys like Kenton and Boyd Raeburn who said go ahead and write whatever you want.
I think the pre-tention might have come from that side. I don't think it was on the writer's side so much.
